note: Startup stall fix (Issue #71): verifyPermission in vault.ts races queryPermission against a 15000ms timeout (same value as the existing EXCLUSIVE_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS fail-safe); on timeout it returns false (permission unconfirmed, never granted), so restoreVaultHandle settles into the designed needs-permission state instead of hanging forever. The ChatScreen startup chain gains a rejection handler on the startup-lock promise that settles vaultStatus to not-connected/unsupported (the same fallback as the existing journal-baseline failure branch) instead of leaving it at checking forever. Exact added / removed lines of vault.ts and ChatScreen.tsx only (never a pattern).
